### `collab.thread_summary` — Thread Summary

Summarises a discussion thread: where it stands, who said what matters, what is unresolved.

**Why it exists.** Catching up on a 60-message thread is how afternoons disappear.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `annotate` — An insight panel attached to the component, with confidence and provenance. |
| Binds to | `Thread` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messages` | list of any | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | string |
| `body` | string |
| `bullets` | list of string |
| `confidence` | number |
| `tone` | one of `neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `ai` |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.thread().ai("collab.thread_summary")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("collab.thread_summary", {"messages": [{"author": "Mira", "content": "Can we ship the importer Friday?"}, {"author": "Noor", "content": "Only if we defer deduplication. Agreed to ship mapping first."}, {"author": "Ada", "content": "I will write the migration guide by Thursday."}]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "title": "Thread summary",
  "body": "Mira: Can we ship the importer Friday? Agreed to ship mapping first.",
  "bullets": [
    "Mira: Can we ship the importer Friday?",
    "Agreed to ship mapping first",
    "Ada: I will write the migration guide by Thursday"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.55,
  "tone": "ai"
}
```

### `collab.merge` — Edit Conflict Mediator

Proposes a merged version when two people edit the same text, and explains what it kept from each.

**Why it exists.** “Your changes could not be saved” makes people choose whose work to destroy.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | string | yes |
| `mine` | string | yes |
| `theirs` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `resolution` | string |
| `strategy` | one of `identical`, `take_mine`, `take_theirs`, `combine` |
| `explanation` | string |
| `confidence` | number |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("collab.merge", {"base": "Ship on Friday.", "mine": "Ship on Friday. Mira owns QA.", "theirs": "Ship on Friday. Docs go out Thursday."})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "resolution": "Ship on Friday. Mira owns QA. Docs go out Thursday.",
  "strategy": "combine",
  "explanation": "Both edits changed the text; kept every distinct sentence. Review before saving.",
  "confidence": 0.45
}
```

### `collab.reply` — Smart Replies

Offers three short, distinct replies to a message: agree, decline, ask.

**Why it exists.** Most replies are one of a few speech acts; composing them from scratch is busywork.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `suggest` — Chips or a ranked list rendered next to the component. |
| Binds to | `Thread`, `TextArea` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | list of object {label, detail, value, action, icon, score} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.thread().ai("collab.reply")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("collab.reply", {"message": "Can we ship the importer Friday?"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "label": "Yes, that works for me.",
      "detail": null,
      "value": "Yes, that works for me.",
      "action": null,
      "icon": null,
      "score": null
    },
    {
      "label": "I can't commit to that yet.",
      "detail": null,
      "value": "I can't commit to that yet.",
      "action": null,
      "icon": null,
      "score": null
    },
    {
      "label": "What needs to be ready by then?",
      "detail": null,
      "value": "What needs to be ready by then?",
      "action": null,

}
```

### `collab.cooldown` — Cool-Down Nudge

Notices when a draft message reads as heated and offers a calmer version before it is sent.

**Why it exists.** Messages sent in frustration cost more than the minute it takes to rephrase them.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `validate` — A coaching message under the field, updated on blur. |
| Binds to | `TextArea` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `ok` | boolean |
| `severity` | one of `info`, `warning`, `error` |
| `message` | string |
| `suggestion` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text_area("notes").ai("collab.cooldown")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("collab.cooldown", {"text": "THIS IS RIDICULOUS!!! The worst rollout ever, useless."})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "severity": "warning",
  "message": "This may read as harsher than you intend.",
  "suggestion": "THIS IS ridiculous. The worst rollout ever, useless."
}
```

### `collab.decisions` — Decision Log

Extracts decisions and owners from a discussion into a durable log.

**Why it exists.** Decisions made in chat are lost in chat.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | `Thread` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messages` | list of any | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `decisions` | list of object {decision, owner, due} |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("collab.decisions", {"messages": [{"author": "Mira", "content": "Can we ship the importer Friday?"}, {"author": "Noor", "content": "Only if we defer deduplication. Agreed to ship mapping first."}, {"author": "Ada", "content": "I will write the migration guide by Thursday."}]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "decisions": [
    {
      "decision": "Agreed to ship mapping first",
      "owner": "Noor",
      "due": null
    }
  ]
}
```

### `collab.mention` — Mention & Reviewer Suggestions

Suggests who to mention or ask for review from the content and each person's expertise.

**Why it exists.** Work stalls when the right person is not in the loop and nobody knows who that is.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `suggest` — Chips or a ranked list rendered next to the component. |
| Binds to | `TextArea`, `Thread` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `people` | list of object {name, expertise} | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | list of object {label, detail, value, action, icon, score} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text_area("notes").ai("collab.mention")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("collab.mention", {"text": "The CSV importer mis-parses dates in column mapping", "people": [{"name": "Ada", "expertise": "data import, parsing"}, {"name": "Noor", "expertise": "billing, invoices"}]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "label": "Ada",
      "detail": "data import, parsing",
      "value": "Ada",
      "action": null,
      "icon": "user",

    },
    {
      "label": "Noor",
      "detail": "billing, invoices",

}
```

### `collab.recap` — Meeting Recap Card

Turns meeting notes or a transcript into a recap card: summary, decisions, next steps.

**Why it exists.** The recap is the only artefact of most meetings, and usually nobody writes it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `compose` — Renders the returned scene inside the component. |
| Binds to | `Generative` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `scene` | scene node |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.generative("A compact order summary with total and status").ai("collab.recap")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("collab.recap", {"text": "The importer now accepts CSV and Excel files up to 50 MB. We decided to ship column mapping first and defer deduplication to the next rel…"})
```
